notes: Account: Arcadia KBScaler — enterprise SaaS offering search + knowledge workflows for mid-market customers.
Primary ask: hosted API for knowledge-base RAG. Moderate index size (estimated 500k-2M passages), high QPS for customer-facing chat and instant search (burst to 800 qps; steady 200-400 qps).

Workload shape: realtime semantic search + 2-stage reranking on top of vector candidate set. Embeddings + ANN for candidate retrieval, Light reranker (instruction-tuned encoder-decoder) per top-10 candidates.

Latency targets: p95 end-to-end < 200ms (search + rerank) for US customers; p99 SLA request for enterprise customers (internal ask: provide options to meet p99 <= 500ms), p95 for EU slightly relaxed due to residency routing.
Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query (avg) <= $0.02 — heavy emphasis from Finance; willing to trade model size for cost if quality preserved.

Model preferences: open-model embeddings (instruction-tuned small embedder) + mid-sized reranker. Open to Redwood model catalog recommendations and quantized variants. Wants deterministic fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained.
Routing needs: multi-region (NA primary, EU for EU-residency customers). Automatic fallback to cheaper variant during bursts preferred. Need route-by-region + route-by-customer-tier policies.
Security: SOC2 required; SSO/SAML + audit logs mandatory for enterprise deals. EU data residency for subset (~10% of revenue customers). KMS for key material.
Quote from Head of Product: "If we can hit sub-200ms at 400 qps with cost at or below our target we can move to a reserved contract."

Current POC plan: ingest 500k doc passage sample, run embedding + ANN search with Redwood hosted API, then rerank top-10 with configurable batching. Evaluate latency (p50/p95/p99), cost per q, and quality (MRR on labeled prompt set).

Technical notes: want control over batching and cache TTLs; interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization + batching) to reduce per-token cost. Concern about cold-start latency for reranker workers on spikes.
Procurement: legal reviewing SOC2 / data processing addendum; security review kickoff 2026-02-28 (initial questionnaire in drive link).
